title: Causal Uplift Modelling and Campaign Decision Economics: A Reproducible Python Framework (v0.6.0)
description:
This Python framework estimates heterogeneous treatment effects and evaluates marketing interventions in randomized experiments. It implements S-, T-, X-, and cross-fitted doubly robust learners, treatment-assignment diagnostics, optional probability calibration, and uplift evaluation with Qini, AUUC, normalized Qini, and bootstrap uncertainty intervals.

Decision-economics tools translate incremental effects into targeting policies, optimize contact budgets under explicit cost and conversion-value assumptions, and produce economic scenario analyses, diagnostic figures, model cards, and stakeholder reports. Nine guided notebooks cover the workflow and its causal assumptions.

The public Hillstrom MineThatData benchmark is supported but must be obtained separately. Synthetic data enable reproducible offline experiments. The software is intended for research and decision support; results depend on identification assumptions, model uncertainty, and context-specific economic parameters.
